title: Yosuga no Sora: In Solitude Where We are Least Alone
author: Sepheryy
reason:
This show is such an emotional melodrama of a show and as a viewer, characters connect to you on an emotional level. Also the theme of the show, soundtrack give off such a dreamcore/weirdcore vibes it feels surreal. Not to mention the ambiguous ending.

Also it's a really wholesome anime with lots of family love.
